verdicts.reason: A keeps the night-city backdrop and layers the headphones over the card, but the logo floats off-centre to the right, the 'OBSIDIAN ONE' eyebrow drops below the subcopy (wrong reading order), the headline runs almost to the card edge, and there is a dead gap between the headphones and the headline. B fills nearly the whole canvas with the card and leaves an odd sliver of city at the right edge, so the city imagery is lost. Its dark headphones sink into the dark card with little contrast, the logo is centred while the headline and the CTA are left-aligned (mixed alignment), and the eyebrow again sits below the subcopy.
